about: SCION 28 assets. Every picture element is a public-domain archive frame (copied into sources/) cut by masks and keys, or computed here. Quick, Draw! drawings are not used. No image from the web, no generative model.
unused_kit: all other found-frames shots (the Survival Stresses seated figure used in round 0 was removed in round 1)

yard_clean.op: tracked median of dog f000-f021 (camera.json track inverted), dog held out by SAM masks

stone.op: crop of yard_clean: the stone pillar

path.op: crop of yard_clean: the sunlit path (porch floor texture)

door_leaf.op: SAM mask of door f031, corner quad from the mask extremes

wall.op: crop of door f031 right wall (switch masked by grade)

room.op: door f031 whole frame as the far wall of the lit room (coats on hooks, closed inner door)

floorwood.op: crop: wooden floor strip under the door

woman0.op: hand-drawn bezier roto (24 vertices, feather 1 px) of the woman in door f000

stonewall.op: running-bond stone wall: 26x20 blocks resampled at random from the stone plate, darkened mortar

flags.op: porch flagstones: 40x40 blocks resampled from the path plate, rotated, joints darkened

arm.op: luma key (0.22..0.34) x bezier garbage matte excluding the card

assets.what: the dog: body plate (torso without head and lower legs)
assets.operation: SAM polygon re-drawn as a bezier mask (erode 0.6 px, feather 1.2 px) x subtract masks for head (expand -3) and belly line (feather 2.5); luma matched to mean 0.40 / std 0.21

assets.what: the dog: fore-far, fore-near, hind legs (hind duplicated, darkened 0.72 and offset 8 px as the far hind leg)
assets.operation: bezier masks (8/6/6 vertices, feather 1.6) x SAM matte; rotated about shoulder/hip pivots with a foot lock (stance 60 %, stride 0.5 m)

assets.what: the dog: head + upper neck (watch, retreat, approach, lying, chin on paws, over-the-shoulder look back)
assets.operation: bezier mask 9 v, feather 2.2; rotated on the neck pivot to the score head/rest values

assets.what: the dog looking back over its shoulder at the door, 7.46-8.0 s, while its body still lies turned away
assets.operation: bezier mask 8 v x SAM matte; parented to the mirrored body at the NECK end, so mirrored with it the face turns toward the door

assets.what: the tail: hangs, tucks with the score tail value, wags, lies on the porch
assets.operation: bezier mask 8 v x SAM matte; hinged on the f010 rump, drawn behind the body

assets.what: the dog: back-of-head plate used while it looks in (26.5-28.35 s)
assets.operation: bezier mask 9 v (extended down the neck so it overlaps the body: no gap) x SAM; rotated -52 deg, scale 0.78, on the neck track; lit from behind

assets.what: the dog turning: turn 1 (3.45-3.95 s) f013 f030 f032 f036, turn 2 (8.0-8.5 s) f038 f037 f013, three/four frames each, each plate with its own single head
assets.operation: SAM bezier matte (choke 1.6 px, feather 1.1); scaled to the f010 height, anchored at the feet; chosen from a cut-out sheet of f013-f041 for one legible head (f016 rejected: head hidden; f040 rejected: smeared double head)

assets.what: the home movie camera motion track used to stabilise the yard
assets.operation: inverted per frame (verified: best integer shift equals -track, frames 5/10/15/20)
tracked median clean plate (dog held out by SAM masks) -> pillar crop -> 26x18 px running-bond blocks resampled at random -> corner pin to the facade quad; dusk grade
path crop of the clean plate -> 40 px flagstones (random rotations) -> corner pin; dusk grade; door light pass
SAM mask (feather 0.7), corner quad from mask extremes, corner-pinned to the leaf swing (24 deg ajar, 98 deg open from 6.2 s)

assets.what: the lit room seen through the door (far wall with coats, an inner door), side wall, wooden floor
assets.operation: corner pins onto interior quads; warm lamp grade x lamp level

assets.what: door casing (white painted wall plate) and the sill board (floor strip)
assets.operation: crops, corner pins, dusk grade; the sill front and top give the sill holdout matte

assets.what: the person: one body through every stage (standing backlit in the doorway, stepping out, sitting on the porch)
assets.operation: hand-drawn 24-vertex bezier roto; plate extended 46 px below the frame edge (the source ends at mid-calf); split at the hip (y=196) into torso and legs, parented on a hip pivot: to sit, the torso lowers and the legs swing 84 deg forward; silhouette grade inside, dusk grade + door light outside

assets.what: the reaching arm (3.4-4.6 s) and the low hand (6.8 s on)
assets.operation: luma key 0.22-0.34 x bezier garbage matte that leaves out the card; mirrored; parented to the person's shoulder
a lamp inside the room shining through the aperture left by the door leaf; one function lights the floor, the sill, the dog and the person
formant-synthesized voice, footfalls on the rig's own foot plants, door creak, room hum, dusk crickets
